title: Miami Spice Back with New Reserve Tier and 300 Restaurants
summary: The 25th edition of Miami Spice Restaurant Months is back from August 1 through September 30, 2026. This year’s program from The Greater Miami Convention & Visitors Bureau (GMCVB) features three-course prix-fixe menus at a minimum of 30% savings at more than 300 participating…
whatHappening: Miami Spice Restaurant Month is returning for its 25th year, running August 1 through September 30, 2026. The program now features over 300 participating restaurants offering three-course prix-fixe menus with minimum 30% savings, and introduces a new Reserve Tier option.
whoInvolved: The Greater Miami Convention & Visitors Bureau (GMCVB) is organizing the event, a destination marketing organization that promotes Miami as a travel and dining destination. The program involves 300+ restaurants across the Miami area participating in the discount initiative.
whyMatters: The expanded program drives tourism and restaurant revenue during the typically slower summer months in Miami. The new Reserve Tier and increased restaurant count create broader dining options for both tourists and locals seeking value, strengthening Miami's reputation as a premier food destination.
moreContext: Miami Spice has been a marquee culinary event for two and a half decades, establishing itself as a major draw for food tourism in South Florida. The introduction of a Reserve Tier suggests GMCVB is stratifying the program to appeal to both budget-conscious diners and upscale seekers, reflecting broader dining industry trends toward tiered experiences. The August-September timing targets the slower summer season when restaurants typically see reduced traffic, making promotional pricing strategically important for venue profitability.

title: PASTA: The Model Miami Restaurant
summary: Very reasonable prices, excellent food across the board, very good service, low noise decibel so you can easily talk, PASTA is a dream restaurant which should serve as a model to others in Miami. I'll even go so far as to say it has the best pasta in Miami. And on top of all…
whatHappening: PASTA restaurant in Miami is being hailed as a model establishment that excels across all key metrics: pricing, food quality, service, and ambiance. The restaurant is earning praise for offering what critics describe as Miami's best pasta in a surprisingly accessible package.
whoInvolved: PASTA is a Miami-based restaurant reviewed by Miami Curated, a local dining and lifestyle publication. The establishment operates as an independent dining venue in Miami's competitive restaurant scene.
whyMatters: PASTA demonstrates that restaurants can deliver premium quality and experience without premium pricing or pretension, setting a benchmark for how Miami establishments should operate.
